title: Selling Plans Opening Requirements by Plan
content:
Before a **Selling Plans** tier can be opened or moved onto, the seller must meet that plan's entry requirements. Every plan requires the seller's identity to be verified; the remaining requirements differ by plan.

| Plan | Identity verified | Store name required | Minimum gross sales in the trailing 12 months | Calendar days after opening within which verification must be completed |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| Individual Seller Plan | Required | No | USD 0 (none) | 30 |
| Starter Store | Required | Yes | USD 0 (none) | 30 |
| Basic Store | Required | Yes | USD 0 (none) | 30 |
| Premium Store | Required | Yes | USD 0 (none) | 30 |
| Anchor Store | Required | Yes | USD 0 (none) | 30 |
| Enterprise Store | Required | Yes | USD 250000.00 | 45 |

## Requirement checks on hypothetical sellers

| Seller (hypothetical) | Plan sought | Identity verified | Store name given | Trailing 12-month gross sales | Requirements met |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| A | Individual Seller Plan | Yes | None | USD 3000.00 | Yes |
| B | Premium Store | Yes | None | USD 40000.00 | No — a store name is required |
| C | Enterprise Store | Yes | Given | USD 250000.00 | Yes — the minimum is met exactly |
| D | Enterprise Store | Yes | Given | USD 249999.99 | No — below the USD 250000.00 minimum |
